outcome: neonatal outcomes (including incidence of low birth weight)
cohort: A total of 290 pregnant women were enrolled in the study in a low-resource setting.
finding: Dietary modifications during pregnancy positively impacted maternal and neonatal outcomes, particularly by increasing birth weight and reducing the incidence of low birth weight.
mod_finding: No significant differences were observed in cesarean delivery rates between the intervention and control groups.
birth_weight: Intervention group: 3122.7 +/- 440.4 g; Control group: 2871.9 +/- 472.6 g
